$comment: Vendor unit costs used by the cost model. Every number carries its source and retrieval date. Re-verify before launch; vendors change prices often.

sync-lipsync-2.label: Sync.so lipsync-2
sync-lipsync-2.source: https://sync.so/pricing (Hobbyist/Creator tier, 25 fps; Scale tier $0.04). Same $3/min via fal: https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/sync-lipsync/v2

fal-latentsync.label: LatentSync (fal)
fal-latentsync.source: https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/latentsync ($0.20 up to 40 s; $0.005/s of output beyond)

fal-kling-lipsync.label: Kling LipSync (fal)
fal-kling-lipsync.source: https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/kling-video/lipsync/audio-to-video ($0.014/s rounded up to 5 s; input video 2-10 s, so long scripts are chunked)

tts.label: ElevenLabs Multilingual v2 / v3
tts.source: https://elevenlabs.io/pricing - conservative effective subscription rate (Creator $22 / 121k credits = $0.18/1k). API page lists $0.08/1k pay-as-you-go; true rate is somewhere in $0.08-0.18.

claude.source: Anthropic model pricing table, cached 2026-10-06 (Haiku 5.5 is $0.10/$0.50 if we want cheaper moderation)

stripe.source: Stripe standard US card pricing - verify for your account/country. Adaptive Pricing passes conversion fee to the customer.

storage.source: Cloudflare R2: ~15 MB/video at $0.015/GB-month, zero egress
